            builder = fea.ChBuilderCableANCF()
            # Set relative positions for starting and ending points of each beam to avoid overlap
            y_offset = i * 0.1
            A = chrono.ChVector3d(0, y_offset, -0.1)  # Starting point ('A' point) of the beam

                10 + i,  # Number of ANCF elements to create along the beam (increasing with each chain)
                A,
                B

            # Retrieve the end nodes of the beam and apply load/constraints
            front_node = builder.GetLastBeamNodes().front()
